build_swav_hook: build a SwAVHook instance with batch size, feature dimension, and queue length for SwAV training
create_frozen_layers_config: create a frozen layers configuration dict mapping layer names to freeze iteration counts for SwAVHook
review_before_train_iter: review the before_train_iter method that freezes and unfreezes model layers based on iteration thresholds
summarize_before_train_epoch: summarize the before_train_epoch method that initializes the feature queue tensor when epoch threshold is reached
test_after_train_epoch: test the after_train_epoch method that saves the SwAV queue to disk at configured intervals
